core_obligations: Invoke the fact that restriction and extension by zero along open immersions are computed by applying the functors to any complex, and choose a representative complex of the given object (proof lines 8098-8101).
Identify the distinguished triangle of the lemma with the one attached to the displayed short exact sequence of complexes of O_X-modules (proof lines 8102-8112).

proof_roadmap: Reduce to an arbitrary representative complex (proof lines 8098-8101).
Recognise the triangle from a short exact sequence (proof lines 8102-8112).
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space X which is the union of two open subspaces U and V, the lemma produces a distinguished triangle whose terms are the extensions by zero of the restriction of an arbitrary object of the unbounded derived category along the inclusions of U, V, the intersection and X itself (statement lines 8083-8095). Since restriction and extension by zero along open immersions are computed by applying the functors to any complex, the author picks an arbitrary representative and identifies the sought triangle with the one attached to a short exact sequence of complexes of modules (proof lines 8097-8112). Exactness of that sequence is checked on stalks using the description of extension by zero for modules, a check the author states rather than writes out (proof lines 8113-8115). The claim is H2: the same pattern as the other Mayer-Vietoris triangles, with the stalk check for extension by zero as the only computation.
